title: 海豚研究致力于动物保护
desc: 海豚研究致力于动物保护

paragraphs.en: Dolphins are what we call charismatic megafauna, which means that people view them as charismatic.
paragraphs.zh: 海豚被我们称作是魅力大型动物，因为它们真的很有魅力。

paragraphs.en: People get excited about some animals more than they get excited about others.
paragraphs.zh: 人们有时候更偏爱某一类动物。

paragraphs.en: But that's okay, because then we can use that to get them to conserve in general.
paragraphs.zh: 但没关系，因为我们可以利用人们的偏爱去保护更多动物。

paragraphs.en: So, if they're conserving the dolphins that means we're conserving their habitat, which means we are conserving all the animals that live in that habitat as well.
paragraphs.zh: 如果人们保护海豚，就会保护它们的栖息地，这也意味着我们同时也在保护生活在那个栖息地的所有动物。

paragraphs.en: Hi, guys. My name is Dr. Kelly Jaakkola. I am a cognitive researcher, right now work with dolphins.
paragraphs.zh: 我是凯利·贾科拉博士，从事认知研究，现在主要研究海豚。

paragraphs.en: You want to do a high five? No? This one? You can't really reach. I know it is hard to reach up here.
paragraphs.zh: 想击个掌吗？不想？这个呢？你其实够不到。我知道这个高度你够不到。

paragraphs.en: For other people, they might get inspired by the dolphin's beauty or their athleticism etc.
paragraphs.zh: 其他人可能对海豚美丽的外形或是运动天赋更感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: I know. Very nice. I know. Oh, you want to come play too? What do you think?
paragraphs.zh: 我知道。非常好。我知道。你也想来玩吗？你觉得呢？

paragraphs.en: For me it was watching them think. Wow, now it's your turn? Now it's your turn?
paragraphs.zh: 我喜欢看着它们思考。现在轮到你了？

paragraphs.en: So, Dolphin Research Center is a non-profit research and education facility in the Florida Keys.
paragraphs.zh: 海豚研究中心是佛罗里达群岛的一个非营利性研究和教育机构。

paragraphs.en: And there are a number of questions that you can't answer in the wild.
paragraphs.zh: 在自然界里有许多问题你无法找到答案。

paragraphs.en: You'll see situations where they seem to be cooperating. They seem to be doing the same thing at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 有时候你会看到海豚似乎在合作。也有可能它们只是恰好在同一时间做着同样的事情。

paragraphs.en: But you can't tell from just looking at that whether or not they're understanding cooperation or if they're just doing something at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 但你仅凭观察无法判断他们是在理解合作，还是只是同时在做某件事。

paragraphs.en: In this study we set up a game. And the game was, we had two buttons and to win the game, the dolphins had to press the buttons at the same time within a one second window which is really, really close.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项研究中，我们设置了一个游戏。游戏内容是，我们有两个按钮，而为了赢得游戏，海豚必须在同一秒的时间窗口内同时按下按钮，这个时间差真的非常短。

paragraphs.en: So, in order to show that they understand cooperation, you have to sometimes send them at different times.
paragraphs.zh: 为了表明他们理解合作，你有时必须让他们在不同时间出发。

paragraphs.en: Okay, so, Reese was sent first. And you see he doesn't go immediately to his button. And now Delta was sent and we'll see, and they did it!
paragraphs.zh: 里斯先被放出来了。但它并没有直接去触碰按钮。现在德尔塔也被放出来了，我们来看看，他们做到了！

paragraphs.en: By the end of this study, they were pressing an average of a third of a second apart which is really tight coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结束时，它们触碰按钮的平均时差是三分之一秒，这是非常紧密的合作。

paragraphs.en: The most obvious next step is okay, well how are they doing it? Are the dolphins using some sort of verbal communication?
paragraphs.zh: 接下来最明显的问题是，它们是如何做到的呢？海豚在用某种语言交流吗？

paragraphs.en: Maybe they are using synchrony, so maybe they sync up with each other and swim together etc.
paragraphs.zh: 也许它们使用了共时性，也许它们会彼此同步，一起游动等等。

paragraphs.en: Other questions we can look at are: are there ways that that cooperation in the wild might be disrupted?
paragraphs.zh: 我们还可以研究其他问题：是否有一些因素会扰乱它们的合作？

paragraphs.en: So, for example, if they are using a kind of vocal communication, then noise pollution might get in the way of that.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，如果海豚在以某种形式的语言交流，那么噪音污染就可能会干扰这种交流。

paragraphs.en: Alright, are you guys ready? Any sort of facility has to have a way of supporting their animals.
paragraphs.zh: 好了，你们准备好了吗？任何动物机构都必须找到方法保护这些动物。

paragraphs.en: And for us, that largely comes from the visitors that walk through the door.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方式主要就是让人们前来参观。

paragraphs.en: One of the big roles that marine mammal facilities play is getting people to make a connection in order to get people to conserve and then care.
paragraphs.zh: 海洋哺乳动物机构的一个重要作用就是帮助人们与动物建立联系，然后让他们去保护动物、关爱动物。

paragraphs.en: And it's that moment of connection that is the start of conservation mindedness.
paragraphs.zh: 这种联系正是动物保护意识的开端。

paragraphs.en: You know, it's fine to give people information. Information is great.
paragraphs.zh: 进行科普是很好的。

paragraphs.en: But that information is only useful if people care enough to actually go out and do something.
paragraphs.zh: 但只有当人们足够关心并真正走出去采取行动时，这些科普才有意义。
